/**
 * Kept: prose inside a tagged block.
 *
 * @remarks Kept: a tagged block stays whole.
 */
export interface Shape {
  /** @remarks Kept: a single-line tagged block above a member. */
  readonly name: string
  /** deleted: a prose-only block above a member */
  readonly label: string
  // deleted: a line comment
  readonly size: number
}

/**
 * Kept: documents the function.
 * @param shape Kept: the shape to measure.
 * @returns Kept: the area.
 */
export function area(shape: Shape): number {
  /** @remarks Deleted: floats inside a function body. */
  const doubled = shape.size * 2
  /* deleted: a plain block comment */
  return doubled
}

/** deleted: prose only, mailing user@example.com about {@link Shape}. */
export const unit = 1

/**
 * deleted: prose only, an inline {@link area} and an @mention mid-sentence.
 * {@link Shape} opens this line but is no tag.
 */
export type Unit = number
